campaign_start_barrier: the hash-bound frozen files in this package remain unchanged
all 15 desired trajectories and all unsafe controls pass zero-send
the correct fixed phone view is recording for H/R and the slot slate is visible
the user explicitly authorizes the exact next motion sequence
finalization_rule: This draft may become FROZEN only after every campaign-start barrier is evidenced and every referenced final artifact is hash-bound. A draft or placeholder file never authorizes ROS or hardware action.
historical_boundary: The 2026-08-28 H/R/C cycles and R2 retrospective closeout remain immutable design/retrospective evidence. They are not the current endpoint and do not occupy this revision's scored slots.
independent_intake_boundary: The previously accepted EXP-S4-030/C115 identity and 15-slot denominator remain unchanged. This local condition/geometry revision is included for independent final intake; no scored result is hidden or substituted.
review_projection_note: Historical pre-start status fields are retained as campaign metadata; final outcomes are recorded under results/final-revalidation/c115/.

selected_scientific_endpoint.claim_if_completed: Report all H/R/C outcomes under the fixed denominator. A 15/15 statement is permitted only if every preallocated slot independently satisfies every prospectively frozen gate.
selected_scientific_endpoint.forbidden_shortcut: Do not replace this endpoint with a C-only or easiest-task supplement, and do not select a favorable family subset after viewing any outcome.

selection_bias_control.after_first_motion: No family, condition, slot, threshold, pair scope, observer rule or denominator may be removed, relaxed or substituted in response to results.
selection_bias_control.before_first_motion: Failure to close any one family blocks the whole 15-slot campaign at 0/15; it does not authorize starting an easier family.
selection_bias_control.outcome_retention: PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN and ABORT remain immutable under their original slot; no favorable rerun replaces them.
selection_bias_control.recovery_boundary: A separately authorized reset or suffix may preserve physical safety and collect missing evidence, but it cannot rewrite the scored disposition of an already ended slot.
